messages:
Alex: Quick check — we have a pulse test scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can someone confirm we have at least 12 A100 GPU-hours reserved under cost center `infra-trials`? Also need the vendor contact for a rack-level power test (APAC fallback).
Meera: Allocations look like: 10 A100-hours on eu-west dedicated pool + 6 A100-hours in apac-preemptible. Total 16h but region mismatch. `infra-trials` cost center is only applied to eu-west right now. If you need APAC under the same cost center that's a manual allocation.
ProcurementBot: Request created #REQ-8421 — tagging finance:cost=infra-trials. Vendor approval ETA ~24h. (auto)
Jamie: FYI I opened the TF PR to add the APAC allocation: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/458 — needs review. @Meera can you check the `cost_center` var? If vendor can't approve in time, we can splice work to eu-west and move latency-sensitive tests to a smaller batch.
Meera: Reviewing PR now. `cost_center` should be `infra-trials` and we also need `billing_project=redwood-staging`. Pushed a small suggestion inline.
Samir: Vendor contact is Nikhil (nikhil@skycloud.io). I pinged him — he said power-test window open 11:00–14:00 PT tomorrow. If procurement approves tonight I can lock the slot.
Alex: Two quick follow-ups: (1) If vendor only provides a rack with 8 GPUs, can we run warmup + priority queue to hit the 12h equivalent? (2) Can we request 2h of burst credits from the dedicated pool to make up the diff?
Meera: (1) Yes — we can redistribute via priority shards. Quick rebalancer script: `scripts/rebalance_priority.py --target-gpus 8 --jobs-file smoke.yaml` (2) Burst credits: we can file a dedicated burst request. Endpoint: POST /api/dedicated/burst-requests payload: {"pool":"eu-west-dedicated","hours":2} — I'll draft the call now.
ProcurementBot: Burst request queued #BR-381, awaiting approvals. (auto)
Jamie: I can review the PR in the next hour. If we need an immediate workaround I can patch workload concurrency to 0.6 and slice inputs — will post a diff if we go that route.
Samir: Nikhil replied: "can do rack power test 11:30 PT, need final PO or ticket link".
Alex: OK — @ProcurementBot / @Meera please post the PO/ticket link here once created. I'll tentatively schedule the test for 11:30 PT. Thanks :thumbsup:
Meera: PO link posted: https://procure.redwood/po/99821 — procurement locked, vendor SK-442 assigned. Also pushed the TF patch to the PR thread.
